business_problem: Conch needed to scale AI across cement production, but traditional model development was slow, hard to generalize, and too weak to support real-time quality, energy, equipment, and safety optimization at industrial scale.
solution_summary: Conch Group used Huawei Cloud Stack to build an AI training center for cement and building-material production. The stack hosts a model program built on Pangu predictive, vision, and NLP foundations so the company can train centrally, infer at the edge, and improve models through cloud-edge collaboration. Fed by large volumes of production and expert data from mining, calcination, conveying, packaging, and plant operations, the platform now supports more than 200 candidate scenarios. On top of it, Conch deployed quality models that predict 3-day and 28-day clinker strength, optimization models that learn kiln-control strategies from multi-source process data, vision models plus distributed fiber sensing for belt and roller anomaly monitoring, and NLP-driven intelligent Q&A for workers. The result is a reusable industrial AI system spanning quality, production, equipment, safety, and knowledge support instead of isolated point models.

solution_components.role: Provides the shared compute environment for Conch's cement-industry AI program.

solution_components.name: AI training center
solution_components.role: Hosts centralized model development, training, and lifecycle management for industrial scenarios.

solution_components.name: Pangu predictive model
solution_components.role: Predicts quality and process outcomes such as clinker strength and process targets.

solution_components.name: Pangu vision model
solution_components.role: Detects equipment and safety anomalies in belt, roller, and plant-monitoring scenes.

solution_components.name: NLP large model
solution_components.role: Turns industry knowledge and expert experience into intelligent question-answering support for employees.

data_flow: Production, equipment, and expert knowledge data is collected into the AI training center on Huawei Cloud Stack, where Pangu predictive, vision, and NLP models are trained and updated. Trained models are then served back into quality control, kiln optimization, conveyor inspection, safety monitoring, and employee question-answering workflows.
business_outcome: Conch moved from isolated AI experiments to a reusable cement-industry model system that improved product prediction, cut energy use and emissions, enabled unattended inspection, and raised safety-monitoring accuracy.
metrics: more than 40 sub-scenarios already delivering results

The implementation combines large models with distributed fiber sensing for equipment monitoring.
Conch positioned the system as the first large model for the cement and building-material industry.
